title: Abarondera Ukuri Bicishije bugufi
intro: Mu gihugu ca kera c’ububasha n’ubupfumu, haraba uguhangana gukomeye. Uruhande rumwe rufise ububasha bw’ibimenyetso vy’Imana, mu gihe urundi rugerageza guhura n’ibidashoboka. Ivyo bizovamwo bizohindura ubuziraherezo ingendo y’amateka. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga k’abo babonye ukuri kw’agahebuzo maze bakicisha bugufi imbere yako?
clues: Twese twaguye mu gupfukama, tutashobora guhakana ukuri .
Twaratahuye yuko ivyo bimenyetso vyava ku Mana imwe y’ukuri .
Twari umuryango wa mbere wakiriye ukwizera mu buryo buteye ubwoba gutyo .
Imigozi yacu n’inkoni zacu vyacitse inzoka imbere y’amaso yacu, yamara twahisemwo kuyoboka .

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Ingorane ivuye ku ngamiya y’ingore y’Umuhanuzi Salih
Urugendo rw'umuhanuzi imbere mu gikoko citwa baleine .

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
